name: Tyvar Kell
aliases: Prince of the elves of Skemfar
description: Tyvar Kell is a planeswalker and elf prince of Skemfar on Kaldheim, the younger brother of King Harald, a boastful stone-shaping warrior who aspires to be a storied hero.

timeline.summary: Tyvar Kell arrives and turns all six Torga trolls to stone with a touch.
timeline.quote: He dodged another blow, turned another troll to stone, and another.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar says Tibalt visited his brother Harald and the elves are now preparing to march against the gods.
timeline.quote: ever since that visit the elves have been preparing for war

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya identifies the portal's destination as Immersturm, realm of demons, and links the plan to the Doomskar.
timeline.quote: Immersturm," said Tyvar.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar opens a doorway into the Cosmos, and Kaya spots his Zendikari charm and realizes he is a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Holy ancients. You're a planeswalker.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Awaken the Trolls" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Tyvar step out of Tyvar's Omenpath into the hot, lava-filled demons' realm.
timeline.quote: On the other side of Tyvar's Omenpath, a blast of hot, noxious air had greeted her.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar explains the gods sealed the realm long ago and that Tibalt must have damaged the wards.
timeline.quote: But Tibalt must have somehow damaged the wards.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: They find an orange molten arrow carved into the basalt, left for them by Tibalt.
timeline.quote: an orange molten arrow

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar unexpectedly grows a bridge of stone across the magma.
timeline.quote: tendrils of rock twining together, knitting themselves into a bridge

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Tyvar about the planes and planeswalkers; he declines to become one.
timeline.quote: But I think I'll pass.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya insists Tyvar needs a code; he refuses her schooling and stalks off down the path.
timeline.quote: With that, he stormed off, down the path of black rock.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Demons on a ship hurl harpoons at Tyvar, and Kaya phases him to save him.
timeline.quote: Kaya reached him just in time, turning his torso to ghostly light

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: A spiked demon longship drives toward them across the magma lake.
timeline.quote: Spikes ringed the outer edge, cruel and narrow

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar beheads the last demon with his heated blade.
timeline.quote: his next slash passed through its neck

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar grows two iron hand-axes from the demon jarl's hammer metal and gives them to the unarmed Kaya.
timeline.quote: Two, actually. Grown from the ground, like stalks of wheat.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: They take the demon longship across the lava toward the Bloodcrag.
timeline.quote: once the demon ship built up speed, it smashed through the plates of cooled magma

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: They see the Bloodcrag, where the light of the gods mirrors the light from Tibalt's portal.
timeline.quote: That's the Bloodcrag!

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Partway up the Bloodcrag, they see hundreds of demon ships on the lava lake, an army.
timeline.quote: The ship we ran across must have been part of their vanguard.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya realizes Tibalt's sword opens portals and means to start a Doomskar; Tibalt answers that he already has.
timeline.quote: Kid, he's going to start a Doomskar!

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt attacks from above with flame, and Kaya charges at him and hurls an axe.
timeline.quote: It clipped his shoulder, sent him sprawling

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar, immune to the doubt magic, blocks Tibalt's killing blow and introduces himself.
timeline.quote: He'd caught that shimmering god-light sword on the dagger fixed to his bracer.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar flips Tibalt over his shoulder and holds a blade to his neck.
timeline.quote: Tyvar grabbed him by his collar and flipped him over one shoulder

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tibalt tells them to go see for himself, then dissolves into cinders and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Like burning paper, his body dissolved into a mass of orange cinders

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: From the peak they see a vast tear in the sky showing a kaleidoscope of other planes.
timeline.quote: they had a clear view of the tear in the sky

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Varragoth and thousands of demons rise from the lava lake and head for the hole in the sky.
timeline.quote: There must have been thousands of them, all headed for that hole in the sky.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar accuses planeswalkers of fleeing when things get hard, and opens an Omenpath to leave.
timeline.quote: You and that Tibalt aren't so different in the end.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya, despite her code, follows Tyvar through the Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Kaya swore, took a deep breath, and stepped in after him.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Into the Demons' Realm" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Arni and Fynn arrive at the Beskir Stronghold, where Inga Rune-Eyes and Sigrid await with strangers Tyvar and Kaya.
timeline.quote: Inga Rune-Eyes, leader of the Omenseekers, had already arrived, and this fortress belonged to Sigrid, God-Favored.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Fynn refuses to accept an elf prince as a friend, and Sigrid reminds him she called him to plan survival.
timeline.quote: I didn't invite you into my hold to insult my guests, Fynn.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: The leaders and Kaya's group ride giant ravens through the sky toward Halvar.
timeline.quote: the giant ravens that now carried them through the sky

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Varragoth strikes the ravens and knocks Kaya, Tyvar and Arni into the air.
timeline.quote: a crunching sound, an avian shriek, and suddenly Kaya was knocked from her perch and into open air

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya catches Arni and Tyvar in the fall and phases all three through the river.
timeline.quote: one more to turn all three of them insubstantial

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: They climb out among the draugr and fight, and Arni stays behind to hold the horde while the others go on.
timeline.quote: You two go on ahead. I'll keep this lot busy.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: The elves of Skemfar march into view, and Tyvar leaves to stop his brother's army.
timeline.quote: the elves of Skemfar, marching to war

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar introduces Kaya to his brother, King Harald.
timeline.quote: Harald, King of the elves of Skemfar, uniter of the tribes of Wood and Shadow.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar thickens the elves' armor as demons press the line.
timeline.quote: He put his hands on the backs of their armor

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Harald says Tyvar prevented him from making a mistake.
timeline.quote: He prevented me from making a mistake, here.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Varragoth, wounded with Tyvar clinging to his back, is bound by Harald's snakes and tears free.
timeline.quote: They wrapped round Varragoth's legs, binding him

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya kills Varragoth by cutting his throat with an axe while he is distracted by Tyvar.
timeline.quote: swung an axe clean through his throat

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Tyvar tells Kaya he wants to see the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: I'd like to see what there is to see, out in your Multiverse.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Battle for Kaldheim" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2021.

timeline.summary: Representatives of Bretagard's clans gather at Beskir Stronghold with Tyvar and Kaya; Sigrid urges unity against the invaders.
timeline.quote: Sigrid urged unity, revealing that the realms faced a shared threat

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Varragoth attacks the heroes on giant ravens; Kaya phases them into incorporeal form to survive the fall.
timeline.quote: Kaya managed to phase them into incorporeal form just before they hit the river below

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tyvar goes to intercept his brother Harald; Cosima washes away an undead troll threatening Kaya.
timeline.quote: until Cosima , God of the Voyage, arrived and washed away the undead with a summoned wave.

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Varragoth intercepts Kaya and Cosima; Tyvar and the elven army united under Harald rescue them and let Kaya and Harald reach Halvar.
timeline.quote: the timely arrival of Tyvar and the elven army, now united under Harald

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Valkyries and Niko Aris pour out of the rift; Kaya phases through Varragoth's arm and cuts his throat with an axe, killing him.
timeline.quote: She phased through the demon's arm and swung an axe clean through his throat.

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Halvar completes the ritual and the Doomskar is sealed, banishing the undead and closing the rifts; the gods vanish; Tyvar accepts Kaya's invitation; Niko learns she cannot return to Theros.
timeline.quote: the Doomskar was sealed, banishing the undead and closing the rifts between realms.

citation.text: "Battle for Kaldheim", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya and Tyvar fail to stop Tibalt from creating a Doomskar, and thousands of demons led by Varragoth attack another realm.
timeline.quote: thousands of demons streamed through a giant rift in space to attack another realm

citation.text: "Immersturm", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya exposes Tibalt behind the troll gathering and escapes with Tyvar's help.
timeline.quote: She quickly saw through the disguise and revealed the planeswalker Tibalt doing his dirty work

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tibalt creates a Doomskar before Kaya and Tyvar can take the Sword of the Realms from him.
timeline.quote: they were unable to prevent Tibalt from creating a Doomskar before they managed to take the sword from him

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya kills the demon Varragoth by cutting his throat with an axe.
timeline.quote: the demon was only stopped by Kaya, who cut the demon's throat with one of the axes Tyvar had made for her

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tyvar praises Kaya for killing Varragoth after the Doomskar ends.
timeline.quote: Tyvar met Kaya and praised her for killing Varragoth

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tibalt, using the Sword, opens an Omenpath for Koma in Starnheim and escapes Tyvar and Kaya to Immersturm.
timeline.quote: Using the Sword, Tibalt escaped both his enemies into the realm of Immersturm .

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tibalt creates a Doomskar before losing the Sword, and demons led by Varragoth attack another realm.
timeline.quote: Led by Varragoth, thousands of demons streamed through a giant rift in space to attack another realm.

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tibalt, disguised as Valki, advises King Harald to prepare for war; Tyvar grows suspicious and investigates.
timeline.quote: Suspicious of this "Valki", Tyvar began to follow and investigate the god through the realms.

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tyvar rescues Kaya at Gnottvold by turning the Torga trolls to stone, and they decide to stop Tibalt together.
timeline.quote: The elf helped Kaya by defeating the trolls, turning them into stone.

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tibalt creates a Doomskar and thousands of demons led by Varragoth stream through a rift to attack another realm.
timeline.quote: they were unable to prevent Tibalt from creating a Doomskar

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tyvar, Kaya and Arni fly toward Halvar with the Sword of the Realms but are attacked by Varragoth and fall near the Dread Marn.
timeline.quote: were attacked in midair by the demon Varragoth who wanted the Sword for himself

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya cuts Varragoth's throat with one of Tyvar's axes, ending the Doomskar; Tyvar resolves to walk the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: the demon was only stopped by Kaya, who cut the demon's throat with one of the axes Tyvar had made for her

citation.text: "Tyvar Kell", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska, the Wanderer, Kaito, Tyvar and Lukka planeswalk in to join, and Kaya wraps the sylex for the journey.
timeline.quote: Soon, others began to planeswalk in.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 5: Exodus" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The group finds a statue of an elf containing Zendikari hedron stone, suspended in cables, and Nahiri declares him one of their own.
timeline.quote: That's a Zendikari hedron.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Nahiri attack the living cables and cut the statue free, and the Wanderer kneels beside him.
timeline.quote: until, with a loud snapping sound, the last one broke and dumped him to the ground

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The freed statue reverts to flesh and introduces himself as Tyvar Kell, Prince of Kaldheim.
timeline.quote: I am Tyvar Kell, Prince of Kaldheim.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The group reaches a Mirran camp where the healer Melira greets them, explaining that Koth told them the planeswalkers were coming.
timeline.quote: You're the ones Koth told us were coming. I'm Melira.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Melira collapses a section of the Facade with explosive charges, dropping the group down to Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: the ground dropped out from under their feet

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri catches the falling earth with her magic and slows their descent to the ground.
timeline.quote: the lithomancer caught hold of them and slowed their descent

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The group leaps into the lacuna to descend toward the Furnace Layer.
timeline.quote: Nahiri leapt without hesitation, and Kaito jumped after her.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaya reunites with Tyvar and Jace, who explains the barrier broke the mindlink and the strike force is scattered.
timeline.quote: The barrier broke that link, along with so many other things.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tyvar prepare their weapons with hexgold.
timeline.quote: breaking his sword into its individual throwing stars

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace and Kaya leave by hand-pumped cart into the tunnel to the Dross Pits, and the rest follow.
